description: The prompt a session was started with from outside (another session, the desktop app, a script), at the very top of its chat instead of a message bubble.
opens: Opening a chat whose first message came from outside (its transcript's turnOrigin isn't human)

parts.name: heading
parts.shows: "Started with this prompt", small bold caption style, dimmed, left-aligned.

parts.name: prompt
parts.shows: Full column width (not a bubble): the prompt's images first if it had any (96px thumbnails in a row, clickable to view), then the prompt as markdown. Past 260px tall it scrolls inside its own box; scrolling past its end scrolls the chat.

parts.name: rule
parts.shows: A horizontal separator under it, 6px above and below.

states.name: chat started by a Bot on the mesh
states.shows: Not used: the task it was given is drawn as an ordinary message instead.

decisions.said: 'Started with this prompt' isn't needed on cross-mesh subagent chats (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app draws the task a Bot started a chat with as an ordinary message, with no 'Started with this prompt' heading; chats started from outside in other ways keep it

decisions.said: A session started from outside with a prompt should show that prompt at the top of the transcript, as scrollable formatted text above a horizontal rule (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app shows the prompt a chat was started with from outside at the very top of its transcript, as markdown in its own scrolling box under a heading, with a rule beneath it
